operations.action: Combine stoichiometric prepared hydrous titanium and zirconium oxides with triethanolamine, and heat with constant stirring until a clear dark-red complex solution forms.
Separately mix the appropriate lead-nitrate amount with deionized water; some nitrate initially remains undissolved.
Slowly pour the hot metal-ion–triethanolamine solution into the lead-nitrate/water mixture to obtain a homogeneous solution.
Heat the combined solution to dehydrate it completely. Subsequent triethanolamine decomposition releases dense white fumes and leaves a voluminous black fluffy mass.
Grind the dehydrated mass into fine precursor powder.
Heat-treat the precursor in air using the selected single-phase PZT condition.
